scientific_question: Does the exact detector normal B=A A^T of a nine-view, non-axis-aligned, parallel-ray BOST voxel-gradient operator decompose into rank-one vertical-by-horizontal Kronecker blocks for every source-view, target-view, and UV-component pair, preserving zero-start CGLS K4 at roundoff?
evidence_role: post-open algebraic view-topology transfer gate after v60.1 and before any scalable implementation, pinhole correction, learned residual, or real-BOST claim

primary_source_geometry_motivation.source: He et al., Neural refractive index field, arXiv:2409.14722v2
primary_source_geometry_motivation.scope_difference: The formal v61 gate uses parallel rays and a regular voxel grid. It does not reproduce the paper's calibrated experimental back-traced rays or pinhole/fiber-bundle optics.

scratch_completed_before_freeze: A small 8^3, 8x8-detector, nine-view parallel-ray matrix was materialised for angles 0,20,...,160 degrees.
All 324 source-view, target-view, and UV-component blocks had numerical Kronecker rank one at relative singular-value threshold 1e-10.
The minimum top-one Kronecker energy fraction was 1.0 in that non-formal scratch.
formal_changes_after_scratch: Formal angles are fixed to nine equally spaced values from 0 to 170 degrees, matching the reported NeRIF numerical span rather than the scratch 0 to 160 degree grid.
Formal random-vector, block-reconstruction, K4 replay, validator, and failure thresholds did not exist in the scratch.
not_seen_before_freeze: No formal v61 result directory exists.
No formal v61 independent validation exists.
No v61 resource timing or memory result exists.
No PoolFire, BLASTNet, validation, fresh, stopping-validation, or untouched-test truth is read.

formal_geometry.ray_model: parallel straight rays rotating in the xy plane

formal_algebra_gate.block_definition: Each B block fixes target view, source view, target UV component, and source UV component, then reshapes detector (v_t,u_t,v_s,u_s) as (v_t,v_s) by (u_t,u_s).

implementation_boundary.reason: v61 is a small structural mechanism audit. Dense matrices are the independent oracle and are not a proposed scalable deployment path.

pass_requires: All 324 blocks pass both rank-one gates.
All five factorized K4 field and residual comparisons pass.
The independent validator reproduces the decision.

next_if_pass: Derive factors from declared one-dimensional vertical and two-dimensional horizontal operator primitives without materialising dense A or B, then freeze a 16x16x32, nine-view, 101-call fresh resource gate. Only after that may a calibrated-pinhole or curved-ray residual correction be learned.
next_if_fail: Stop exact Kronecker transfer and preregister a bounded block-low-rank approximation with explicit field/residual error, matched-accuracy refinement, wall, and memory gates before any learned correction.
